title: The Artificial Intelligence Job Shift: Navigating the Future of Work
description: Explores AI's impact on employment, offering strategies to navigate job automation, reskilling, and emerging career opportunities.
short_description: A no-hype introduction to AI in the future of work, built around real applications, limits, and better judgement.
author: Jonathan Harris
audience: A practical overview of AI in the future of work for managers, workers, founders, and readers tracking labour-market change.
